description.short_caption: Facial lesions consistent with cryptococcosis in an immunocompromised patient.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the lower face of a patient with multiple, discrete, dome-shaped papules and nodules, some of which appear umbilicated. The lesions are distributed across the cheeks, chin, and perioral region. The skin appears otherwise intact, with no visible ulceration or crusting. The findings are consistent with cutaneous manifestations of cryptococcosis, often seen in immunocompromised individuals.
visible_findings: distribution across cheeks, chin, and perioral region
